verdict.rationale: Lever's own Automation Hub is documented as automatically handling routine actions such as archiving, tagging, emailing and advancing candidates, and nurture campaigns follow up automatically. The evidence never describes how users define the rules, the trigger conditions or the event model behind this automation. Webhooks are outbound event callbacks, a developer building block rather than a rule engine, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented user-defined rule/condition configuration, an explicit list of event triggers and supported actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
